context: Reference implementation: checked IO boundary kept out of lambdas.

checklist.name: Creates the requested artifact
checklist.description: Creates PermitFiles.java with the method, the nested record, the provided parse method, needed imports, and Java 17-compatible code.

checklist.name: Preserves the exception contract
checklist.description: An IOException from Files.readString reaches the caller as an IOException (not UncheckedIOException), IllegalArgumentException from parse propagates unchanged, and file order is kept.

checklist.name: No try/catch inside a callback
checklist.description: No lambda or method reference body catches IOException; the code does not wrap the read in UncheckedIOException inside map or forEach.

checklist.name: Uses a visible checked boundary
checklist.description: Reads happen in a plain loop or a named helper method that declares IOException, so the checked boundary is visible at the call site.

checklist.name: No unwrap-rewrap ceremony
checklist.description: Does not throw UncheckedIOException in a stream and catch it again to rethrow the cause, and does not introduce a throwing-function wrapper type.

checklist.name: Stays focused
checklist.description: No unrelated abstractions, parallel reads, extra public API, or dependency changes.
